# V9: GossipSub parameters (Standard Profile 1)

gov5's GossipSub values as a wire contract (G4), with the topic strings (G2), the message id (G3) and the router's
message-size cap after Profile 1's `maxBlockBytes` (B15). Generated by gov5 from its p2p code
(`pubsubGossipParam`, `pubsubOptions` constants, `GossipMaxSize` after `encoder.SetMaxBlockBytes`,
`peerScoringParams`, `topicScoreParams`, `MsgID`, the topic registry):
`go test -tags nosqlite,noboltdb ./internal/p2p -run TestProfile1VectorV9`
(`N42_PROFILE1_VECTORS_UPDATE=1` rewrites the file; `N42_PROFILE1_VECTORS_MIRROR=<dir>` also writes it to `<dir>/V9/`).
The test fails if the file differs from what gov5 computes.
gov5 commit: 8c6fae38 (branch feat/p1-vectors-e2); go-libp2p-pubsub v0.18.0.

## File `gossipsub_parameters.json`

| Section | Content |
| --- | --- |
| `genesisHash`, `forkDigest` | V1's genesis; fork digest = first 4 bytes of the genesis hash |
| `topics` | every topic in gov5's registry: exact string (`/n42/<digest hex>/<name>/ssz_snappy`, H2-v4 `/n42/h2/4/ssz_snappy`), whether G2 lists it, which scoring set gov5 registers for it |
| `messageIds` | `keccak256(genesisHash ‖ topic ‖ data)[:20]` for four (topic, data) pairs |
| `router` | StrictNoSign, no author, max message size 78293706 B (= snappy max encoded length of 64 MiB; decoded cap 64 MiB), seen-messages TTL 30 s, time cache 385 s, queue sizes 1024 |
| `gossipSubParams` | the full router parameter struct: D 8, Dlo 6, Dhi 12, Dlazy 6, Dout 2, Dscore 4, heartbeat 700 ms, history length 6, history gossip 3, the rest libp2p v0.18.0 defaults |
| `peerScoreThresholds`, `peerScoreParams`, `topicScoreParams` | peer scoring (the four named topic sets: block, consensus, voluntaryExit, lightweight); `PeerScoreParams.Topics` is filled per joined topic from `topicScoreParams` |

Durations are in milliseconds.

## Notes

- Peer scoring runs only with discovery on; a node with discovery off (explicit peer list) runs without it.
- Mesh, gossip and scoring values are local router behaviour: a client with other values still interoperates. Topic
  strings, the message id and the size cap must match exactly.
- `blob_sidecar` is not in G2, but gov5 subscribes to it on every chain, Profile 1 included.
- `zk_proof` is in gov5's registry but no service joins it and `topicScoreParams` refuses it (no scoring branch).
- The `mobileverify_cohort_*` topics are gov5-only (not in G2); they are joined only when the cohort coordinator runs.
